reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (  -- one row per price version, with the product's launch price, current price and number of versions
  SELECT ph.product_id,
         FIRST_VALUE(ph.list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id ORDER BY ph.valid_from
                                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS launch_price_eur,
         LAST_VALUE(ph.list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id ORDER BY ph.valid_from
                                             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS current_price_eur,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history ph
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
)
SELECT DISTINCT product_id, launch_price_eur, current_price_eur,
       ROUND(current_price_eur / launch_price_eur, 3) AS price_index
FROM versions
WHERE n_versions > 1
alternatives:
WITH bounds AS (  -- one row per Audio product with more than one price version: its first and latest valid_from
  SELECT ph.product_id, MIN(ph.valid_from) AS first_from, MAX(ph.valid_from) AS last_from
  FROM price_history ph
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
  GROUP BY ph.product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT b.product_id, f.list_price_eur AS launch_price_eur, l.list_price_eur AS current_price_eur,
       ROUND(l.list_price_eur / f.list_price_eur, 3) AS price_index
FROM bounds b
JOIN price_history f ON f.product_id = b.product_id AND f.valid_from = b.first_from
JOIN price_history l ON l.product_id = b.product_id AND l.valid_from = b.last_from

SELECT DISTINCT v.product_id, v.launch_price_eur, v.current_price_eur,
       ROUND(v.current_price_eur / v.launch_price_eur, 3) AS price_index
FROM (
  -- one row per price version, with the product's launch price, current price and number of versions
  SELECT ph.product_id,
         FIRST_VALUE(ph.list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id ORDER BY ph.valid_from
                                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS launch_price_eur,
         FIRST_VALUE(ph.list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id ORDER BY ph.valid_from DESC
                                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS current_price_eur,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.product_id) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history ph
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
) AS v
WHERE v.n_versions > 1

solver.query:
SELECT ph.product_id,
       ARG_MIN(ph.list_price_eur, ph.valid_from) AS launch_price_eur,
       ARG_MAX(ph.list_price_eur, ph.valid_from) AS current_price_eur,
       ROUND(ARG_MAX(ph.list_price_eur, ph.valid_from) / ARG_MIN(ph.list_price_eur, ph.valid_from), 3) AS price_index
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
GROUP BY ph.product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
